intro: The project so far is the site you are reading.

items.title: yukki rui · bilingual blog
items.text: A bilingual blog built from scratch: Markdown authoring with static output at build time, a browser-based admin, a no-login comment section on Cloudflare D1, Pagefind search and archive pages, plus per-post share images and JSON-LD generated during the build. One repository deploys to both Cloudflare Pages and GitHub Pages.

items.title: Source code
items.text: All the code is public, including the pre-release gates: type check, unit tests, dead-link checks for both deployment paths, and browser end-to-end checks.
